survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note is descriptive and does not conduct student-level large-scale assessment modeling (no microdata analysis, no plausible values, and no ML estimation). The figures and indicators are drawn from Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables, which aggregate administrative and survey sources into comparable cross-country statistics. Because the note does not specify any analytic subsample construction, weighting variables, or replicate-weight procedures, there is no basis to identify student or replicate weights for an estimation model. For users who access the underlying Education at a Glance 2025 indicator methodology and technical notes, the appropriate weighting and variance estimation approach is defined per indicator source; this note itself only reports indicator outcomes for Iceland.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values are not applicable because this document is a country note summarizing education-system indicators (e.g., attainment, unemployment by education level, completion rates, expenditure, teacher salaries) rather than analyzing cognitive achievement scores from an ILSA with PV-based scaling. Missing-data handling is not reported because the note does not describe any student-level estimation procedure or imputation/deletion strategy; it instead presents already-compiled OECD indicators from multiple underlying data sources. As a result, the methodological details for missingness are handled within the indicator-specific data collection and processing pipelines referenced by the OECD technical notes, not within this short descriptive note.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used OECD Education at a Glance 2025 indicator data for Iceland (latest available year for each indicator). The note does not define an analytic student-level subsample or inclusion/exclusion criteria; it reports compiled cross-country indicators and trends, with references to the corresponding OECD tables and indicator-specific methodology.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Iceland provides descriptive indicators across tertiary education and other system areas, emphasizing trends and cross-country comparisons rather than estimating relationships with student-level models. It reports changes in attainment-related unemployment among 25–34 year-olds, the share of master’s degree holders, participation and progression into bachelor’s programmes, completion and dropout patterns (including pandemic-era changes), international student mobility, and education spending by level and as a share of GDP. It also summarizes teacher and learning-environment indicators such as teacher salary changes, instructional time, school holidays, subject allocation, and class size. Benchmarks are presented as OECD averages and distributions, with indicator-specific references to OECD tables and methodology documents. Because the note is not an empirical ML/predictive study, it does not specify PV handling, missing-data procedures, or weighting/replicate design for an analysis model.
